title: 'I couldn't be silent': Iranian teen's mother seeking justice after daughter shot dead
description: BBC Panorama follows grieving Samira who - after the killing of Sevda - faces up to the Tehran regime.
text: In a year marked by protests, crackdowns and war, ordinary Iranians have found their lives turned upside down.
BBC Panorama follows a grieving mother, Samira, who takes on the regime after her teenage daughter, Sevda, was shot dead while protesting on the outskirts of Tehran.
